description: This file serves as the main entry point for a React frontend application. It sets up context providers for theme, authentication, cart, and wishlist states, defines route guards for admin and customer access, and configures routing for various pages including product catalog, detail, checkout, order confirmation, wishlist, and admin sections with protected routes.

classes.name: RequireAdmin
classes.description: A React component that restricts access to admin routes, redirecting non-admin users to the admin login page.

classes.name: RequireCustomer
classes.description: A React component that restricts access to customer routes, redirecting unauthenticated users to login/signup page.

methods.name: RequireAdmin({ children })
methods.description: React component for admin route protection using useAuth to verify admin status.

methods.name: RequireCustomer({ children })
methods.description: React component for customer route protection using useAuth to verify customer authentication.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React component that wraps the application in various context providers, sets up routing, and includes common UI components like Navbar and CartSidebar.
